_comment: Factions (generated by tools/gen_mobs.py). Standing = default + race_mods[race] + what deeds earned, clamped to -2000..2000. Killing a member applies 'hits'. Its members attack on sight at threatening (-750) and below; service NPCs of the faction refuse you from dubious (-500). See server game/factions.hpp.
